events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe, read gate, check AUDIT rows
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; sed -n 800,822p cloud/src/agentic.ts; grep -nE "^\| (X014|X015|N009|N011|N012|N015|N018|N028) " /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-40,300-460 | head; grep -nE "\| (X014|X015|N009|N011|N012|N015|N018|N028) \|" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | grep -oE "(X014|X015|N009|N011|N012|N015|N018|N028) .*" | awk -F'|' '{print $1, $NF, $(NF-1)}' | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count passes, tsc, field check, key names
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -cE "^PASS"; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|midnight|N012" | head -5; (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -3; echo tsc=$?); grep -n "fieldProblem\|cal_title" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | grep -i "free\|\\$" | head -3; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ | head; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs | grep -n "TANTRA\|process.env" | head

events.text: Now the live read-only sender check with tantra-workshop.key (GET only, key not printed).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run read-only Tantra sender check
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; K=$(head -c 400 ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/^[A-Z_]*=//'); TANTRA_TEST_API_KEY="$K" node cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs [email] 2>&1 | tail -3; echo exit=$?; TANTRA_TEST_API_KEY="$K" node cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs [email] boards@fintechcircle.com 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
